cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
path = 'parsing/html/reader_test.go'
s = open(path).read()
s = s.replace('''\t// Comment text should not appear.
\tif v.MapLen() > 2 {
\t\tt.Fatalf("expected only head/body keys")
\t}''', '''\t// Comment text should not appear.
\tkeys, err := v.MapKeys()
\tif err != nil {
\t\tt.Fatal(err)
\t}
\tif len(keys) != 2 {
\t\tt.Fatalf("expected only head/body keys, got %v", keys)
\t}''')
open(path, 'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w parsing/html/reader_test.go && go test ./parsing/html/ -run 'TestReader' -v 2>&1 | tail -80
